notes.title: 1/26 Update More Bug Fixes and a New Walkthrough!
notes.content:
Bug fixes:
Version 1.3: Equipment works on any party member, repainting quarters now lasts, several typos fixed.

Check out our helpful [url=http://www.hodeaka.com/stupwalkthrough.html] Walthrough	[/url] at Hodeaka!

Thanks to everyone who's played Save the Universe, Please! We hope to have more fun stuff soon.
